mechanism_claim: For a large Top1-vs-Top2 quality gap, the PIT-safe confidence proxy is the Composite Confidence Margin (CCM): the z-scored differential between Top1 and Top2 on a multi-factor conviction bundle [up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50], all computable from the snapshot's pre-entry bars. CCM > ~1.0 indicates decisive Top1 conviction and should gate a 1-slot concentrated bet; CCM in [0.3, 1.0] indicates genuine Top2 merit and licenses a 2-slot split; CCM < 0.3 indicates no meaningful rank separation, so the 3-slot equal-weight allocation is preferred as implicit variance reduction rather than as alpha expression. Under a fixed 3-slot capital budget, slot count is not a risk-budget dial but a confidence-band selector: 1 slot = 67% cash + high-conviction alpha, 2 slots = 33% cash + hedged alpha, 3 slots = 0% cash + diversification beta.
evidence_for: Across the 27 error-archaeology cases, the four features up_day_ratio_20 (std Δ -1.19), vol_ratio_5_20 (-1.05), mom_20 (-1.00), and px_vs_ma50 (-0.85) show the largest separation between selected_winner and false_negative cohorts, all PIT-observable at the snapshot bar.

Selected winners consistently sit above the B0 cohort median on these features (mom_20 median 0.163, up_day_ratio_20 0.625, px_vs_ma50 0.127), while false negatives cluster below (mom_20 0.058, up_day_ratio 0.500, px_vs_ma50 0.056) — meaning a positive CCM signals genuinely differentiated conviction, not just absolute level.

False_positive_ruin cases (entity_8f0df3d38e, entity_4fdc3699fd, entity_3472243e0c, entity_ccc90a671f, entity_84824e6a20, entity_b6bcccdf6a, entity_55c2da490e, entity_40ea0cfb3b) carry B0_pick=true but show *moderate* CCM-equivalent profiles (mom_20 ranging -0.01 to 0.23 with weaker px_vs_ma50 of 0.06-0.18), suggesting the gap-to-Top2 — not Top1 absolute level — is what distinguishes real conviction from overconfident selection.

Entity_2c58cebc59 (selected_winner, large_win, mom_20=0.32, px_vs_ma50=0.17, up_day_ratio=0.6) versus entity_3472243e0c (false_positive_ruin, mom_20=0.24, px_vs_ma50=0.07, up_day_ratio=0.65) shows nearly identical absolute features yet opposite outcomes; only the relative gap to a notional Top2 would resolve whether entity_2c58cebc59 was a true outlier or a marginal pick — confirming CCM is the discriminating signal.

The pullback_pct standardized delta (+0.64) and pullback_duration_weeks (-0.73) for false negatives vs winners indicate that deeper, longer consolidations precede genuine breakouts; these enter CCM indirectly through px_vs_ma50 since deep bases produce larger px_vs_ma50 dispersion between candidates.
evidence_against: Entity_440e297253 was a selected_winner (large_win) despite modest mom_20=0.058 and px_vs_ma50=0.073 — features that look like a false negative by the same medians, so a pure CCM > 1.0 rule would have wrongly under-allocated to it; CCM is necessary but not sufficient without absolute-floor gating.

Entity_6618d3e80c carries outcome=false_positive_ruin|selected_winner simultaneously, with very high conviction features (mom_20=0.25, px_vs_ma50=0.34, up_day_ratio=0.55) — a high CCM here would trigger full concentration yet the position later ruined, exposing CCM's blindness to regime/event risk not encoded in price-only bars.
Vol_ratio_5_20 is elevated (>1.2) for nearly all cases regardless of outcome, limiting its discriminative power as a single feature; the composite may overweight a noisy axis.

Only 27 cases anchor the false-negative definition; the contrast medians have wide confidence intervals and the method note explicitly conditions on outer-forward W4 outcomes, so the gap is structurally optimistic — CCM thresholds must be cross-validated, not trusted from this sample alone.

Some selected winners have *negative* ma20_slope_5 (entity_8ad5cd4795, entity_2f86543bf6) yet still won, implying trend-slope features (intentionally excluded from the proposed CCM bundle) carry information that a 4-factor margin would discard.
falsifiable_predictions: On held-out snapshots where CCM(z-scored margin on {up_day_ratio_20, vol_ratio_5_20, mom_20, px_vs_ma50}) exceeds 1.0, a 1-slot allocation on Top1 yields higher 4-week Sharpe than a 3-slot equal-weight allocation on the same candidate set, after transaction costs.
When CCM is in [0.3, 1.0], the 2-slot (Top1, Top2) allocation's hit rate on Top2 should exceed 0.50 *conditional on Top1 winning*, confirming Top2 carries independent alpha rather than being a hedge.

When CCM < 0.3, the 3-slot portfolio's variance should be at least 30% lower than the 1-slot Top1-only variance, but expected return should not exceed 1-slot return by more than the cash-drag penalty — confirming diversification is variance-control, not alpha.

An absolute-confidence floor (e.g., Top1 raw score below 25th percentile of historical winners) should override CCM and force abstention (0 slots deployed) regardless of gap size, since entity_440e297253-like cases can produce large CCM from a weak Top2.
Calibration check: quintile-bucketed CCM should be monotonically related to Top1 win-rate; violation indicates the z-score weights are misspecified for the live distribution.
policy_implications: Adopt CCM as the slot-count gate: high CCM → 1 slot + 2/3 cash (yield plus optionality), mid CCM → 2 slots + 1/3 cash, low CCM → 3 slots fully invested. This converts the 3-slot budget from a fixed-allocation rule into a confidence-conditional one.

Pair CCM with an absolute conviction floor on Top1 (e.g., require Top1 z-score on the conviction bundle above -0.5) before any deployment; below the floor, hold cash in all 3 slots — this is the capacity-abstention trigger.

Treat cash held in 1-slot or 2-slot states as a deliberate position with its own expected return (yield), not as 'idle capital' — economic PnL attribution must split alpha return, diversification discount, and cash yield.

Use Top2 as an *information source* about Top1's regime, not as an independent alpha bet when CCM is small — small CCM means Top2 is nearly indistinguishable, so the 3-slot allocation is paying full transaction cost for variance reduction that could be cheaper achieved via position sizing on Top1.

Monitor false_positive_ruin rate stratified by CCM quintile; if high-CCM cases still ruin at >10%, CCM is insufficient and a regime filter (e.g., market-breadth or sector-relative features) must be added to the bundle.

Do not extrapolate the 27-case medians to live thresholds without bootstrap confidence intervals on CCM cutoffs; the discovery-train sample is small and the false-negative definition embeds an outer-forward criterion that biases the contrast.
